effects: Bash deals additional damage equal to 350-450% of armour value.
Preparation reduces all ability cooldowns by 12 seconds.
Reflect returns 100% of incoming damage plus 10-15% of armour value, and affects 8 additional targets.
Revenge duration and cooldown are doubled, and its maximum stacks rise to 20.
body.name: Steadfast Will

assumptions: Bash keeps its ordinary 20-100% roll over ability damage plus the wielded shield or defender armour stat plus visible Defence level, then adds 350-450% of equipment Total Armour to one combined hit band.

The combined Bash band shares one critical outcome, Damage Potential roll path, modifier chain and hit cap. The live card does not disclose separate-hit, rounding or critical behavior for the armour term.

Preparation reduces every active single-slot cooldown and independent charge-recovery clock by 20 ticks, excluding Preparation itself. A clock that would finish is left at the next tick, the simulator's smallest non-zero remaining cooldown.
Bash and Preparation require a genuinely wielded shield or defender. Bone Shield casting is not represented.
excluded: Preparation's ordinary incoming-hit reduction for Resonance and Divert
Reflect, because outgoing DPS requires incoming hit damage and timing
Revenge, because its damage stacks require incoming attack timing

reason: Add the sourced Steadfast Will Bash and Preparation mechanics to shield DPS simulation while keeping incoming-hit effects explicit.
